what_changed.b79c: class=field, reason=base-slot-partial (unresolved) -> the three rows existed as ABI_CONTRACT_PROVIDER_HW_TABLE
what_changed.b80: class=resolved, reason=base-slot (unresolved=False) -> the witness never ran, so the rows disappeared
what_changed.mechanism: the generic `field` rule keys its store map by the raw displacement across every type (`field_stores[off]`, `field_open`) and evaluates functions in order; a site analysed before the function that opens that displacement resolves, an identical site analysed after it does not
what_changed.direct_evidence: in this exact image `field_open` contains 0xf0 in its final state (court/freeze-b80/e7probe-b80.json: field_open_0xf0=true) while all three sites are recorded resolved (reason=base-slot); the opening store is therefore later in the pass than ossl_gcm_one_shot
what_changed.cross_check: the resolver's own target sets equal the witness's enumerated table leaves exactly, so the resolution is not wrong -- it is weaker and unstable

row_rederivation.rule: S5b: provider_hw_table_witness is evaluated on every enumerated hw-table site, resolved or not; when it accepts, the row is re-recorded from the table symbols/leaves and the resolver's class is retained as resolver_class
row_rederivation.narrowing_guard: the row is accepted only when the resolver's target set is a subset of the witness's; a witness narrower than the resolver refuses (hw-witness-narrower-than-resolver), so this path can never shrink a resolved set
